evals.prompt: Review this pull request against main with pr-smellz. Focus on introduced regressions and missing tests; do not edit anything.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the merge base, scopes review to changed lines plus minimal dependencies, validates findings, runs targeted checks, and writes a findings-first PR_REVIEW.md without edits.
expectations: States the mode line before review
Runs scripts/changed_scope.py with the resolved base and head
Writes one neutral evidence pack with requirements, the full diff, and revision-pinned excerpts
Runs Pareto and Correctness from that pack
Reads repository guidance and only necessary dependency context
Every finding is anchored to an added, modified, or removed line
Drops pre-existing, speculative, and style-only issues
Runs targeted checks or records why they are unavailable
Writes PR_REVIEW.md with findings first and a DONE line
Does not edit, commit, or post comments

evals.prompt: pr-smellz --quick: review this 35-line parser diff against main.
evals.expected_output: Uses quick mode with no spawned passes. Pareto, Correctness, and any triggered Product or Security check run inline from the shared pack.
expectations: States a quick mode line with Pareto, Correctness, triggered Product or Security checks, and independent: no
Does not spawn reviewers
Runs a triggered Product or Security check inline instead of dropping it
Applies Pareto inline and checks parser correctness from the shared pack
Inspects changed hunks and necessary parser tests
Does not broaden into repository cleanup
Writes PR_REVIEW.md

evals.prompt: Run pr-smellz --thorough on this authentication and database migration PR.
evals.expected_output: Uses all five lenses once on one evidence pack, prioritizing Pareto. Product checks migration rollback, Security checks authorization, and findings are validated with a trace or focused check.
expectations: Selects thorough mode and runs Pareto, Correctness, Product, Maintainability, and Security
Lenses read only the shared pack and return JSON; the parent writes each findings file
A lens past available concurrency runs inline and the mode line sets independent: no
Product checks migration and rollback; Security checks removed or weakened authorization
Supplies a requested excerpt and reruns only that lens; a leftover request stays a coverage gap
Deduplicates findings and preserves concrete evidence

evals.prompt: Review this PR with pr-smellz --fix, apply accepted minimal fixes, and rerun the affected tests.
evals.expected_output: Reviews first, then uses the explicit fix permission for minimal scoped edits and targeted verification without committing or posting comments.
expectations: Completes and validates review findings before editing
Applies only minimal fixes for accepted findings
Reruns targeted tests after fixes
Does not commit or post review comments
Reports fixes and residual risk

evals.prompt: Run a broad code-smellz cleanup across this whole repository and apply safe fixes.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke pr-smellz because there is no PR/diff review scope; routes to code-smellz.
expectations: Does not require a merge base
Uses code-smellz rather than pr-smellz

evals.prompt: Address the three review comments already left on my PR and push the fixes.
evals.expected_output: Does not rerun pr-smellz; addresses the supplied comments directly and does not push without explicit authorization.
expectations: Does not launch a fresh PR audit
Works from the supplied review comments
Does not push without authorization

evals.prompt: Use pr-smellz to review PR #123 without changing my current branch or worktree.
evals.expected_output: Reads PR metadata and patch through gh, uses local objects when available, and never checks out or fetches over the user's work without permission.
expectations: Runs gh pr view for title, body, base/head names and OIDs, and files
Uses changed_scope.py if both commit objects exist locally
Falls back to gh pr diff --patch when the commits are unavailable
Asks before fetching missing objects for deeper context
Does not run gh pr checkout or switch the current branch
Produces the same changed-line evidence contract as a local review

evals.prompt: Run pr-smellz --standard on this PR: a one-provider export endpoint now has a provider registry, three wrappers around the same serializer, and separate copies of the format defaults. The PR goal is to add CSV export alongside JSON.
evals.expected_output: Runs Pareto and Correctness, plus Product and Maintainability, over one evidence pack. Verifies concrete ways to remove unnecessary machinery while preserving CSV and JSON export.
expectations: Runs Pareto and Correctness, Product for the caller-visible export, and Maintainability for the registry, wrappers, and copied defaults
Runs Security unless the pack shows no trust boundary, removed safeguard, dependency, configuration, or reachable input
Lenses read only the shared pack; the parent writes their JSON
Checks callers and contracts, via the pack or one evidence-request rerun, before claiming wrappers or defaults are redundant
Names concrete deletion or reuse proposals and their maintenance or behavior impact
Shows how the smaller solution preserves the stated export goal
Anchors every finding to an added, modified, or removed line and rejects speculative complexity complaints
Orders findings by severity with Pareto first among equally severe findings

evals.prompt: Run pr-smellz --fix on this PR. Its description explicitly requires a second export backend for an existing customer. The diff also introduces a duplicate serializer and accidentally removes an authorization check. Prefer subtraction.
evals.expected_output: Uses Pareto to propose verified simplifications without treating its priority as permission to drop explicit requirements or downgrade a security regression.
expectations: Treats the authorization regression according to its impact even if Pareto findings have lower severity
Checks whether serializer reuse preserves backend-specific behavior before consolidating
Does not remove the required backend without user agreement; any challenge states the lost benefit
Preserves or restores required security safeguards
Applies only verified scoped fixes and reruns affected checks
